The severity should be viewed as moderate-to-severe for the interaction zone, even if the rest of the image is just blurry.

While the visible flipper is morphologically plausible for a grey whale, the absence of head features and distinctive barnacle patterns makes positive identification difficult. The low classifier confidence combined with missing diagnostic checkpoints results in a low alignment score.
